subject.title: feat(control-ui): add cron calendar timeline view

question: Should OpenClaw accept a built-in Control UI cron timeline now, and if so should this stale branch be refreshed/repaired or replaced against the current Cron page architecture?
rationale: The PR implements a new user-facing feature, covers only part of the linked feature request, and currently has correctness and compatibility blockers that automation should not resolve without a maintainer choosing the product slice.

options.title: Request a refreshed narrow timeline
options.body: Ask for a rebased or replacement PR that preserves current cron.status fields, uses scheduler-accurate timing/status data, and regenerates locale outputs before review.

options.title: Pause for broader calendar design
options.body: Keep the canonical issue open but do not repair this branch until daily, weekly, editing, heatmap, and popup behavior are scoped together.

options.title: Decline core calendar view
options.body: Close this PR and the canonical issue if maintainers decide cron calendar visualization should not live in core Control UI.

recommendation.title: Request a refreshed narrow timeline
recommendation.body: Ask for a rebased or replacement PR that preserves current cron.status fields, uses scheduler-accurate timing/status data, and regenerates locale outputs before review.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest recent ownership signal across the current Cron Jobs page and cron service/status surfaces affected by the decision.
